behavior: AC1: the build writes flyer/index.html with a Letter @page rule, an inline SVG QR, no script, no img and no foreign host
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_flyer.py -k 'one_letter_sheet_in_print or no_script_image or resets_the_catalogs'

behavior: AC2: the QR's module matrix is segno's for exactly the UTM URL, and the host is printed under it
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_flyer.py -k 'url_is_the_origin or exactly_the_matrix or another_url or follows_the_origin or address_is_printed'

behavior: AC3: no phone in any form, no sms:/tel:, no email and no $ on the flyer
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_flyer.py -k 'no_phone or no_email or no_price'

behavior: AC4: categories, car and date come from the data; no em dash and no invented urgency
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_flyer.py -k 'categor or car or date or em_dash'

behavior: AC5: the page is noindex and nothing else links to it
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_flyer.py -k 'kept_out_of_search or nothing_else_links or every_other_crawler'

behavior: AC6: headless Chrome prints /flyer/ on exactly one US Letter sheet
verification: uv run leaving-denver build && uv run pytest -q tests/test_flyer_browser.py

behavior: AC7: the end build makes no flyer, sweeps a stale one and redirects /flyer and /flyer/* to /
verification: uv run pytest -q tests/test_flyer.py tests/test_smoke_end_of_sale.py -k 'end_build or swept or flyer_address or smoke'

behavior: AC8: the playbook names /flyer/ and every class of the flyer template is in the compiled stylesheet
verification: uv run leaving-denver build && uv run pytest -q tests/test_flyer.py tests/test_class_coverage.py -k 'playbook or flyer'
